title: Building a website
scene: Anna wants a website for her podcast. Max buys a domain and hosting on a web server, plans the web design and a redesign of the logo, works on the back end and the interface, checks every pixel in a web browser, explains rendering, post-processing of photos and a real-time chat, makes the router a hub for their devices and shares big files peer-to-peer.

words.ex: We bought a domain for our new website.
We pay for website hosting every year.
Our website runs on a fast web server.
She took a course in web design.
The website got a complete redesign this year.
He works on the back end of our website.
The new app has a simple interface.
This photo is 1,000 pixels wide and 600 pixels tall.
Open the link in your web browser, please.
The video rendering took three hours on my laptop.
Most of my photo editing happens in post-processing.
The app shows real-time traffic updates for your route.

title: A visit to a data center
scene: Max's team visits a data center. The admin shows them rows of servers and an old mainframe, explains the cache and the firewall, shows how each batch of data travels on the Internet Protocol, why cloud computing is cheap, how a transmitter works and why the ping is low.

words.ex: The company built a new data center in Texas.
Ask the admin to reset your password.
The server is down, so the site doesn't work.
The bank still uses an old mainframe.
Clear your browser cache if the page looks wrong.
The firewall blocked the suspicious connection.
The system processes each batch overnight.
Every device online uses the Internet Protocol.
Cloud computing saves companies a lot of money.
The radio transmitter sends signals for miles.
My ping is too high to play online.

title: Anna's data science course
scene: Anna takes a data science course. She learns how an algorithm finds a cluster in big data and a dataset, how each parameter and coefficient works, draws a vector, a gradient, parallel lines and a spiral in one quadrant of a graph, and hears that in high tech an android may soon do this work.

words.ex: She wants to study data science at the university.
The app uses an algorithm to suggest new songs.
The company runs its website on a cluster of servers.
Our company uses big data to understand customers.
We need a bigger dataset for this project.
You can change this parameter in the settings.
In 3x, the coefficient is three.
A vector has both size and direction.
The background uses a blue-to-purple gradient.
There are clear parallels between these two stories.
Draw a spiral on the paper.
Plot the point in the upper right quadrant.

title: A physics lesson
scene: In physics class Taras learns that everything is made of atoms. The teacher explains electrons, protons and neutrons, light as photons and the tiny quark, sound that cannot travel in a vacuum, plasma in lightning, an impulse and resonance, and shows a magnet.

words.ex: Everything around us is made of atoms.
An electron has a negative electric charge.
A proton has a positive electric charge.
A neutron has no electric charge.
A photon is a tiny particle of light.
A quark is smaller than a proton.
Sound cannot travel through a vacuum.
Lightning is a form of plasma.
The nerve sends an electrical impulse to the brain.
The glass broke because of resonance.
Put the photo on the fridge with a magnet.
After the factory closed, the town was in stasis for years.

title: Max's science project
scene: Max helps Taras with a science project about electricity. They measure watts and volts, check the voltage and the ohms, read about henrys and other SI units, make a battery with an electrode, an ion, nickel, cobalt and zinc, and read about a nuclear reactor.

words.ex: This light bulb uses sixty watts.
This small battery gives one and a half volts.
Check the voltage before you plug it in.
This resistor has a resistance of one hundred ohms.
The henry is the unit of inductance.
The meter is the SI unit of length.
The nurse placed electrodes on my chest.
An ion has a positive or negative charge.
Nickel is used to make stainless steel.
Cobalt is used in phone batteries.
Zinc helps your body fight colds and infections.
The nuclear reactor provides power to the city.

title: In the chemistry lab
scene: Anna's friend works in a chemistry lab. She shows Anna hydrogen, sulfur and neon, explains an oxide, a chloride, a sulfate and an isotope, a polymer, peroxide, ether and graphite, and a chrome machine that studies a meteorite; she says that amphetamine is made in labs too, but it is a dangerous drug.

words.ex: Water is made of hydrogen and oxygen.
Rotten eggs smell a bit like sulfur.
Neon lights glowed above the bar all night.
Iron oxide is the red color of rust.
Sodium chloride is ordinary table salt.
This shampoo is free of sulfates.
Carbon has several isotopes with different numbers of neutrons.
Plastic is a type of polymer.
Clean the cut with hydrogen peroxide.
Doctors once used ether to put patients to sleep.
Pencil lead is actually made of graphite.
A meteorite landed in the field last night.
The old car had shiny chrome bumpers.

title: Chemistry at home
scene: Anna reads the labels on things at home: silicone baking molds, latex gloves, nitrate and phosphate in fertilizer, ethanol in hand gel, ethylene glycol in the car, an aerosol spray, beta-carotene in carrots, pigment in paint and minerals in water. Dad warns her about carbon monoxide, cyanide and dynamite, and shows her a quartz watch.

words.ex: These baking molds are made of silicone.
Some people are allergic to latex gloves.
Too much nitrate in water can be harmful.
Phosphate helps plants grow strong roots.
Many cars can run on fuel with ethanol.
Ethylene glycol is the main part of antifreeze.
Don't use aerosol sprays near an open flame.
Carrots and pumpkins are rich in beta-carotene.
The paint gets its color from pigment.
Milk is rich in minerals like calcium.
Carbon monoxide has no color and no smell.
Cyanide is a very dangerous poison.

title: A night at the observatory
scene: Anna and Max visit an observatory. Through a telescope they see a bright object, an asteroid and a meteor; an astronaut talks about the cosmos, its genesis, a lander on Mars and neutrinos from the sun, and a guide explains the zenith and the zodiac.

words.ex: We looked at the moon through a telescope.
I saw a strange bright object in the sky.
A small asteroid passed close to Earth last night.
We watched a meteor cross the night sky.
The astronaut spent six months in space.
The stars fill the vast cosmos.
Scientists study the genesis of the universe.
The lander touched down safely on the surface of Mars.
A neutrino can pass right through the whole Earth.
The sun reached its zenith at noon.
There are twelve signs in the zodiac.
The volcano has a huge crater at the top.

title: Anna's psychology experiment
scene: For her psychology class Anna runs an experiment. She explains every factor, element and indicator, keeps her focus, talks about ego, a priori ideas and the placebo effect, a paradox and a social construct, a continuum of feelings and stasis, and her professor praises her scientific skepticism.

words.ex: We did a fun experiment in class.
Price is an important factor for me.
Trust is an important element of any friendship.
The color change is an indicator of acid.
The photo is out of focus.
Don't let your ego stop you from asking for help.
You can't know that a priori; you need to test it.
The pill had no medicine; it was the placebo effect.
It's a paradox that more choices make us less happy.
Many people say that time is a social construct.
Colors form a continuum from light to dark.
Scientists met the claim with skepticism.

title: Genes and germs
scene: Anna's aunt works in a biotech lab. She studies the human genome, shows Anna a clone and a mutant fly under the microscope, explains how a microbe makes a toxin and how an enzyme or an inhibitor works, and how scientists fight Ebola and anthrax.

words.ex: She works for a biotech company near the university.
Scientists mapped the human genome.
The sheep in the photo is a clone.
The movie is about a mutant with special powers.
Look at the cells under the microscope.
Microbes live everywhere, even in our bodies.
The liver removes toxins from the body.
Enzymes help the body digest food.
The new medicine is an inhibitor that slows the virus.
Ebola is a very dangerous virus.
Anthrax is a dangerous disease of animals and people.
Actin is a protein that helps muscles move.

title: Brain, mood and hormones
scene: A lecture at medical school explains the brain: neurons in the cortex, receptors and serotonin, how an antidepressant works, and what happens in mania, paranoia, amnesia and autism. The professor also talks about testosterone and estrogen, the reflex in the knee, the protein actin, every organ, and the placenta in the first trimester.

words.ex: The brain has billions of tiny neurons.
The cortex is the outer layer of the brain.
The drug blocks certain receptors in the brain.
Serotonin is a brain chemical that affects your mood.
The doctor prescribed an antidepressant.
During his mania, he barely slept.
His paranoia made him trust no one.
After the accident, he suffered from amnesia.
Her son was diagnosed with autism last year.
Testosterone is a male hormone.
Estrogen is an important hormone in the female body.
The doctor tested the reflex in my knee.

title: Medical school
scene: Anna's friend Ira studies at medical school. In anatomy class they work with a cadaver and a scalpel and learn about the abdomen, the appendix, the pancreas, the aorta, the digestive tract and the anus; in the hospital she sees triage, anesthesia, a catheter and a muscle spasm, and reads how doctors once used chloroform.

words.ex: Medical students study anatomy on a cadaver.
The surgeon asked for a scalpel.
He felt pain in his lower abdomen.
The doctor removed his appendix last year.
The pancreas makes insulin to control your blood sugar.
The aorta is the biggest blood vessel in the body.
The digestive tract is about nine meters long.
The doctor examined the patient's anus.
In the emergency room, triage decides who goes first.
The surgery was done under general anesthesia.
The nurse put in a catheter after surgery.
He felt a sharp spasm in his back.
I want to be an organ donor.
